entries.title: Genesis 10:1
segments: Now these are [the] generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth. And sons were born to them after the flood.

entries.title: Genesis 10:2
segments: The sons of Japheth: Gomer and Magog and Madai and Javan and Tubal and Meshech and Tiras.

entries.title: Genesis 10:3
segments: And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz and Riphath and Togarmah.

entries.title: Genesis 10:4
segments: And the sons of Javan: Elishah and Tarshish and Kittim and Dodanim.

entries.title: Genesis 10:5
segments: By these were the coasts of the nations divided in their lands, every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.

entries.title: Genesis 10:6
segments: And the sons of Ham: Cush and Mizraim and Phut and Canaan.

entries.title: Genesis 10:7
segments: And the sons of Cush: Seba and Havilah and Sabtah and Raamah and Sabtecha. And the sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

entries.title: Genesis 10:8
segments: And Cush fathered Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one in the earth.

entries.title: Genesis 10:9
segments: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD. Therefore it is said, Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the LORD.

entries.title: Genesis 10:10
segments: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

entries.title: Genesis 10:11
segments: Out of that land he went forth [to] Assyria. And he built Nineveh, and the city Rehoboth, and Calah,

entries.title: Genesis 10:12
segments: and Resen between Nineveh and Calah, which [is] a great city.

entries.title: Genesis 10:13
segments: And Mizraim fathered Ludim and Anamim and Lehabim and Naphtuhim,

entries.title: Genesis 10:14
segments: and Pathrusim and Casluhim (from whom came the Philistines) and Caphtorim.

entries.title: Genesis 10:15
segments: And Canaan fathered Sidon, his first-born, and Heth,

entries.title: Genesis 10:16
segments: and the Jebusite and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,

entries.title: Genesis 10:17
segments: and the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

entries.title: Genesis 10:18
segments: and the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite. And afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.

entries.title: Genesis 10:19
segments: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon (as you come to Gerar) to Gaza, as you go in towards Sodom and Gomorrah and Admah and Zeboim, even to Lasha.

entries.title: Genesis 10:20
segments: These [were] the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.

entries.title: Genesis 10:21
segments: And to Shem were born, even him, the father of all the sons of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder.

entries.title: Genesis 10:22
segments: The sons of Shem: Elam and Asshur and Arpachshad and Lud and Aram.

entries.title: Genesis 10:23
segments: And the sons of Aram: Uz and Hul and Gether and Mash,

entries.title: Genesis 10:24
segments: And Arpachshad fathered Salah; and Salah fathered Eber.

entries.title: Genesis 10:25
segments: And two sons were born to Eber. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. And his brother's name [was] Joktan.

entries.title: Genesis 10:26
segments: And Joktan fathered Almodad and Sheleph and Hazarmaveth and Jerah,

entries.title: Genesis 10:27
segments: and Hadoram and Uzal and Diklah,

entries.title: Genesis 10:28
segments: and Obal and Abimael and Sheba,

entries.title: Genesis 10:29
segments: and Ophir and Havilah, and Jobab. All these [were] the sons of Joktan.

entries.title: Genesis 10:30
segments: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as you go to Sephar, a mountain of the east.

entries.title: Genesis 10:31
segments: These [are] the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, and after their nations.

entries.title: Genesis 10:32
segments: These [are] the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations. And from these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.
